title: Scam Filter SDK boundary — algorithm 0.2.0, wire contract 2
description: Structural SDK boundary contract for RuleSpec, normalized inputs/outputs and the signed envelope. The native adapter translates SDK rule fields to scam-filter 0.2.0. Numeric algorithm contractVersion 2 is distinct from SDK envelope schema 0.1. Runtime signature, provenance, capability and semantic validation remain in Core. Unix times are safe-integer milliseconds, durations integer seconds and rule change thresholds basis points. See README.md for semantic checks.

unixMs.description: Unix milliseconds, not seconds. Ordering, request-bound and no-future checks are semantic validation.

decimalInteger.description: Canonical unsigned decimal; no sign, whitespace, exponent, fraction or leading zeros. Parsed bounds are checked before arithmetic.

reserve.description: Raw integer units, including zero. Enforce the uint256 numerical upper bound semantically; 78 decimal digits alone do not prove uint256 range.

windowSec.description: Also require windowSec <= lookbackSec in semantic validation; not expressible with ordinary sibling references in this schema.

changeMode.description: Vocabulary proposal, not a promise that either mode is implemented. Require an agreed algorithm capability.

reversalBps.description: The algorithm capability must define the reference value, reversal confirmation and allowed range; no universal 10000 bps cap is imposed here.

eventKinds.description: MVP counts these events across X1 only. No windowSec/X2 or implicit guarantee that a provider can retrieve each event kind.

timeInterval.description: Half-open missing interval [fromMs, toMs). fromMs < toMs, clipping and interval normalization are semantic checks. No invented observations or cross-gap events.

snapshotPoint.description: Zero quote reserve is a valid liquidity observation and, when token reserve is positive, a valid zero price. Zero token reserve makes price unavailable, breaks that metric's segment and prevents clear. Positive-to-zero is a valid -100% move; zero-to-positive does not create a percentage event.

poolHistory.description: Boundary state and every changed block's final reserves, not sampled grids or raw logs. Dambi owns the builder. fromMs includes the maximum X1 and warm-up. Points have unique ascending times and constant decimals. bucketMs is resolution metadata. warmup.complete asserts faithful changes and explicit gaps, not complete coverage or recovered algorithm state. No interpolation across unknown data or swapCounts.

ageLowerBoundMs.description: Verified pool-age lower bound in milliseconds, not a Unix timestamp and not cumulative trade count. Preserve supporting provenance in the SDK wrapper.

tokenProfile.description: Optional age fields do not imply age zero. Pool creation uses verified factory PairCreated, never first Mint; consistency of exact age and a supplied lower bound is a semantic check. Missing/unavailable events cannot be represented as a verified empty history.

analysisRequest.description: Effective frozen rules after candidate selection; validate unique rule IDs and required capabilities. This slim algorithm input does not replace plan/factory/confirmation/bundle/settings provenance in the outer SDK contract.

algorithmBinding.description: Equality to the invoked request and canonical rules-hash recipe are mandatory semantic checks, not established by matching this object shape.

evidenceWindow.description: R2 evidence window is (startMs, endMs], selected by maximum event count and then latest endMs. Check horizon, size and ordering semantically.

evidenceEvent.description: Event-kind interpretation must match the specific rule and declared algorithm capability; a non-empty kind alone is not proof of support.

algorithmRuleResult.description: observed and threshold are event counts; window_drop uses threshold 1 while its bps threshold stays in RuleSpec. Fired evidence remains valid with partial coverage; clear requires faithful history, complete coverage and required initial state. Evidence truncation must not change observed count. No NaN or Infinity.

scamAnalysis.description: One result per requested enabled rule with exact identity/version/binding. Dambi validates and maps outcome/reason into SDK state/reasons; the algorithm does not compute final allow/deny or override policy fail-closed. Stub output never becomes a real safety claim.

payload.description: Original UTF-8 JSON text. Verify without parsing/re-serialization; full payload validation is a separate boundary.

signature.description: Canonical padded Base64, 64-byte P1363 r||s. Local ECDSA P-256/SHA-256. This only validates encoding, not a signature.

keyId.description: Optional telemetry, never chooses or introduces a trusted key. Wire key_id mapping is an adapter concern.
